risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing-suspect mail delivered (T1566.002), impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa (T1078.004), API-created inbox forwarding rule to external d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (T1114.003 - classic ATO persistence/exfiltration), and bulk SIS access from 185.220.101.7 within 60 min (T1213). The rejected password-spray claim (shared NAT background noise) does not weaken the independently confirmed takeover evidence.
